title: Add launch-intent preview for operational capabilities
purpose: Let operators start capabilities safely by previewing the intent and authority path before dispatch.
scope: Generate typed intent.submit previews from selected workflow and input draft.
Show resulting expected authority path: AgentCore planner, SecurityExecutionEngine, approval and rollback.
Reject unsafe free-form shell fragments in capability inputs.
Redact secret-like input before render, history or evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Capability launch preview never executes directly.
High-risk capability launches show approval and rollback expectations.
Unsafe input fails closed before intent submission.
Preview output remains deterministic and redacted.
failure_modes: Launch preview bypasses typed intent grammar.
Workflow input shell fragment reaches planner.
Preview stores raw secret in command history.
